edit.statement: 'Lives in mutualism with' is not symmetric: A living in mutualism with B no longer implies that B lives in mutualism with A.
edit.subject: mutualist_of
edit.original: 'Lives in mutualism with' is symmetric: mutualism is a two-way partnership, so each partner lives in mutualism with the other.
edit.scope: Mutualistic partnerships between species; only the reverse direction changes.
